slide1.title: Hotels and chalets in Val Gardena, with exclusive FursaDolomiti benefits
slide1.text: Discover a hand-picked collection of partner hotels rated 4 and 5 stars, plus chalets available to book direct, with extra perks and personal recommendations.

slide2.title: Find your perfect Dolomites getaway
slide2.text: Whether you are planning a family holiday, a romantic escape or an active break, my curated hotel selection and personal advice will help you find the right fit.

slide3.title: The right location makes all the difference
slide3.text: I will help you choose between Ortisei, Santa Cristina and Selva, so the lifts, walking trails, restaurants and finest Dolomites views are all close at hand.

slide4.title: Local knowledge is your advantage
slide4.text: Get first-hand advice on where to stay, ski and hike, where to rent your gear and what is truly worth seeing during your time of year.

slide5.title: More than just a booking
slide5.text: FursaDolomiti guests receive personal recommendations, partner perks, special offers and support both before arrival and throughout their stay.

slide6.title: Better rates on ski and bike rentals
slide6.text: Enjoy special terms on ski, snowboard and bike hire from trusted partners in Val Gardena, whether you book online or arrange everything once you arrive.

hero.quote: I have lived in the Dolomites and worked in tourism in Val Gardena for over 20 years. I help guests from around the world find the right hotel or chalet for their perfect stay. You can explore the options yourself or get in touch with me — I will reply personally and share my recommendations.

alpenroyal.name: Alpenroyal 5★
alpenroyal.description: Secluded hotel with high level of service and calm atmosphere in Selva
features: Shuttle to the lifts (3-5 minutes)
Panoramic spa with pools and saunas
Fine dining restaurant (Michelin)
With good snow cover, a ski-in descent to the hotel is prepared

edenselva.name: Edenselva 4★
edenselva.description: A cozy hotel in the center of Selva, with direct access to the Sellaronda ski route and a calm atmosphere for relaxing at any time of year
features: Cozy and relaxing atmosphere
Ski-in/Ski-out with direct access to the famous Sellaronda ski route
Panoramic outdoor Jacuzzi & wellness area
Eco-friendly ClimaHotel® built with natural wood

posta.name: Family Hotel Posta 4★
posta.description: A family-friendly hotel with children's playrooms and entertainment services for children aged 3 and older
features: In the heart of Santa Cristina
Cozy family atmosphere for holidays with children of any age
Modern interiors in comfortable and spacious rooms
Delicious South Tyrolean and Italian cuisine with welcoming and attentive staff

continental.name: Continental 4★
continental.description: Located next to the lift and ideal for recovery and relaxation after an active day, away from the noise and bustle.
features: Ski-in / ski-out with direct access to the famous Sellaronda ski route
Comfortable rooms in modern Alpine style with beautiful views of the Dolomites
High level of cuisine and service
Panoramic rooftop pool with breathtaking views of the Dolomites

lunaMondschein.name: Luna Mondschein 4★
lunaMondschein.description: Comfortable hotel with extensive spa facilities and convenient access to active holidays
features: Just a few minutes on foot to the center of Ortisei and 5 minutes by hotel shuttle to the lifts
Elegant Alpine atmosphere with cozy rooms in traditional Tyrolean style and modern comfort
An elegant historic hotel with a warm family atmosphere and impeccable service
Spacious spa area for complete rest and recovery

luxuryChaletP.name: Luxury Chalet P
luxuryChaletP.description: Elegant natural-wood chalets combining Alpine traditions, modern comforts and exclusive design
features: 6 exclusive apartments, ideal for a large group of up to 24 people
Set on a sunny slope at the edge of the forest, with magnificent panoramic views of Ortisei
Daily in-room breakfast and eco-friendly housekeeping service
Large spa area with indoor pool, sauna and relaxation zone

villaCarolina.name: Villa Carolina
villaCarolina.description: An exclusive chalet for maximum comfort and privacy, with panoramic views of the Dolomites
features: Breathtaking views of the Sassolungo and Sella massifs from almost every living area
Private sauna, mountain-view jacuzzi and fitness room for maximum comfort and recovery
Close to the Col Raiser lift
With good snow conditions, you can ski to within 100 m of the chalet

chaletZenit.name: Chalet Zenit
chaletZenit.description: A high-end modern chalet in an elegant Alpine style with natural wood throughout
features: 3 exclusive apartments, ideal for a large group of up to 12 guests
Morning transfer to the lifts, only 500 m from the Sellaronda slopes
Ski-in access, with the chalet just 100 m from the slope in good snow conditions
Private spa zone directly inside the apartments

howItWorks.title: How to book and receive your bonus
howItWorks.note: Booking through FursaDolomiti is more than a convenient way to find the right hotel for your stay. It gives you access to bonuses that are not available with a direct booking.
howItWorks.help: If you need help choosing a hotel or chalet, message me and I will help you find the right option.
howItWorks.disclaimer: The size and format of the bonus depend on the hotel and booking period. Bonuses are not guaranteed during high season.

steps.title: Choose a hotel or chalet
steps.text: Only four- and five-star hotels that I have worked with personally for many years.

steps.title: Go to the hotel website
steps.text: Click “Book with a bonus” to open the form and enter your details.

steps.title: Enter your name, surname and email
steps.text: This lets me identify you as a FursaDolomiti guest and prepare your personal bonus.

steps.title: Use promo code FURSADOLOMITI
steps.text: When searching or booking a room, enter the promo code in the dedicated field or add it to the booking comments.

steps.title: Book independently
steps.text: If you book on the hotel’s official website, enter the promo code FURSADOLOMITI in the dedicated field or add it to the booking comments.

steps.title: Receive your bonus at check-in
steps.text: I will personally prepare a bonus for your stay, and it will be waiting for you when you arrive.

reasons.title: I am always directly in touch with you
reasons.text: From the moment of booking until the end of your trip, I personally answer your questions about the resort.

reasons.title: Direct booking without intermediaries
reasons.text: You go to the hotel’s official website and complete the booking yourself.

reasons.title: Confidentiality
reasons.text: Your personal data is not used for newsletters and is not published.

reasons.title: Personal help on request
reasons.text: If questions come up or it is hard to choose, message me. I will help you orient yourself.

reasons.title: You receive booking bonuses
reasons.text: When booking through FursaDolomiti, a bonus will be waiting for you at check-in; I agree the terms personally with each hotel.

reasons.title: I know the hotels personally
reasons.text: I live in the Dolomites, in Val Gardena, and suggest only hotels I can genuinely recommend.

personalSelection.title: Didn’t find the right option?
personalSelection.note: If nothing on the website feels quite right, get in touch. I also work with other hotels and private chalets in Val Gardena and will help you find the best option for your stay.
personalSelection.help: Personal selection is available by individual request.
personalSelection.videoTitle: Want to see the hotel before booking? I will make a personal video review for your request.

instructor.lead: In high season, good instructors get booked quickly.
instructor.text1: I work with trusted schools and instructors I know personally.
instructor.text2: I arrange bookings directly, taking skiing level and age into account.

dolomitesExpert.title: Over 20 years in the Dolomites
dolomitesExpert.quote: A good holiday starts with choosing the right location and stay.
dolomitesExpert.author: — Tatiana Fursa
dolomitesExpert.stayTitle: Hotels, chalets and apartments in Val Gardena
dolomitesExpert.stayText: I help you choose accommodation in Ortisei, Selva di Val Gardena and Santa Cristina, from family hotels and spa hotels to luxury chalets and modern apartments in the Dolomites.
dolomitesExpert.yearRoundText: Val Gardena is one of the most popular destinations for ski holidays in winter and active mountain holidays in summer. The region suits family trips, romantic escapes, holidays with friends, hiking routes, cycling and time in nature.

locations.text: Ortisei is ideal if you like developed infrastructure and the atmosphere of a resort town
Santa Cristina is chosen for a calm stay and beautiful views
Selva di Val Gardena is best for being close to the slopes

dolomitesExpert.help: Not sure what to choose? I will select the right option personally
